evidence.positive: Patched the container entrypoint to accept extra JVM flags, pointed spring.mail.host/port at a node SMTP sink on the host (host.docker.internal:2525) with mail.debug on, and restarted the same container. (1) Shipped classpath (/app/jib-classpath-file, sha256 8d2fd524...) carries exactly jakarta.mail-api-2.1.5.jar + angus-mail-2.0.5.jar; no com.sun.mail:jakarta.mail and no javax.mail jar. (2) Started demo case patient-1/case-1 via POST /api/app-launch, then POST /api/feedback as loopuser (X-Tenant-Id demo-demo) returned 200 true; the sink stored mail-01.eml (From noreply@guidedclinical.com, To guidedorfeedback@guidedclinical.com, Subject 'GuidedOR - New Feedback Submission') and the app log showed 'DEBUG: Jakarta Mail version 2.1.5', 'successfully loaded resource: jar:file:/app/libs/angus-mail-2.0.5.jar!/META-INF/jakarta.providers', 'getProvider() returning jakarta.mail.Provider[TRANSPORT,smtp,org.eclipse.angus.mail.smtp.SMTPTransport,Oracle]' and 'DEBUG SMTP: message successfully delivered to mail server'. (3) OpenShift email path: restarted with -Dspring.profiles.active=openshift-guidedor-tst,local,docker (tst first so the docker datasource still wins); app booted ('The following 3 profiles are active'). Provoked an ERROR log (POST /api/feedback with bogus X-Tenant-Id 'demo' -> 'Servlet.service() for servlet [dispatcherServlet] ... threw exception'); the logback SMTPAppender delivered mail-02.eml to the sink: From mghguidedor@mgb.org, To tnguyen-cao@mgh.harvard.edu, jephron@mgh.harvard.edu, rducharme@mgh.harvard.edu (all from logging.smtp.* in the tst yml), Subject 'GuidedOR Error (https://guidedor-dev.partners.org)' with the closing parenthesis present, body containing the 'threw exception' line.
evidence.negative: (1) Ran a probe (/tmp/Probe.java via the container JDK's source launcher) against the app's exact -cp string: Class.forName('com.sun.mail.smtp.SMTPTransport'), 'javax.mail.Session' and 'com.sun.mail.util.MailLogger' all threw ClassNotFoundException; jakarta.mail.Session loaded from jakarta.mail-api-2.1.5.jar; Session.getTransport('smtp') resolved to org.eclipse.angus.mail.smtp.SMTPTransport and the provider table listed only org.eclipse.angus.* entries. (2) Under the shipped local,docker profiles two ERROR-level log events (17:21:40 and 17:21:51, the failed feedback posts) produced no email at the sink — the only message received in that window was the later feedback notification — confirming the EMAIL appender stays profile-gated to openshift-guidedor-tst|prod. (3) A WARN-level event in the tst run produced no appender mail; only the ERROR did.
evidence.red_check: Copied the pre-fix com.sun.mail:jakarta.mail:2.0.2 jar (sha256 536f0ae5...) from ~/.m2 into /app/libs and rewrote /app/jib-classpath-file to the pre-fix order (jakarta.mail-api-2.1.5, angus-mail-2.0.5, then jakarta.mail-2.0.2), restarted the same container, and posted feedback again. The app log went red: the provider table now contained 'com.sun.mail.smtp.SMTPTransport=jakarta.mail.Provider[TRANSPORT,smtp,com.sun.mail.smtp.SMTPTransport,Oracle]' alongside the Angus entry, and the send resolved 'getProvider() returning jakarta.mail.Provider[TRANSPORT,smtp,com.sun.mail.smtp.SMTPTransport,Oracle]' — the old implementation won the smtp protocol under a 2.1.5 API, i.e. the duplicate-implementation hazard the ticket removes. Reverted: restored the original classpath file (sha256 matches the backup 8d2fd524...), deleted /app/libs/jakarta.mail-2.0.2.jar, restarted, re-posted feedback — mail-04.eml arrived and the log again showed the org.eclipse.angus SMTPTransport provider; probe re-run confirmed com.sun.mail/javax.mail absent. Over the whole container log the com.sun.mail getProvider line appears exactly once (the red window) and the Angus line twice (before and after).

caveats: The OpenShift appender path was exercised by layering the openshift-guidedor-tst profile under local,docker inside the throwaway container with spring.mail.host/port redirected to a local SMTP sink; reachability of phsmgout.partners.org:25 from the real OpenShift pods was not tested here.

The openshift-guidedor-prod profile was not booted; its logging.smtp.* / spring.mail.port values were only read from the yml (same shape as tst) and are covered by the shipped SmtpLogbackAppenderTest parameterized check, which was not run in this session.
Logback's SMTPAppender builds its own Session without mail.debug, so provider selection for the appender send is evidenced by the delivered mail plus the classpath probe rather than by debug lines.
The container entrypoint patch (extra JVM flags file with mail host/port/debug) was left in place at exit; the classpath file and /app/libs were restored to the shipped state and checksum-verified.
mgb-soap-client's exclusion of the transitive javax.mail 1.6.5 was verified only by its runtime absence (probe ClassNotFoundException), not by any MGB SOAP call.

automation.assessment: SmtpLogbackAppenderTest already covers the appender end to end via GreenMail (relay, from, both recipients, escaped subject, ERROR-only threshold) and asserts both OpenShift ymls define host/port/from/to. The explicit classpath test was deliberately dropped in the follow-up commit, so re-adding one is a judgment call. InternalNotificationService has no test at all; the real gap is the feedback-to-email path through Boot's JavaMailSender, which is what the duplicate implementation actually affected.
proposed_tests: InternalNotificationServiceTest (GreenMail, same extension as SmtpLogbackAppenderTest): sendSimpleInternalNotification delivers to every configured address with subject prefix, from and reply-to defaults, and body as HTML.
InternalNotificationServiceTest: no JavaMailSender bean / empty notification-addresses -> nothing sent and no exception.

Optional single-assertion classpath guard in orci: Session.getInstance(new Properties()).getTransport("smtp") is org.eclipse.angus.mail.smtp.SMTPTransport and com.sun.mail.smtp.SMTPTransport / javax.mail.Session are not loadable (only if the team wants the dropped guard back).

jira_comment:
Verdict: deploy-ready.

Positive: The running image ships only the Angus jakarta.mail implementation, and both a feedback notification and the OpenShift SMTP appender email (profile openshift-guidedor-tst, relay redirected to a local sink) were delivered with sender, recipients and the fully parenthesised subject taken from the profile properties.
Negative: com.sun.mail and javax.mail classes are not loadable on the app's classpath, and ERROR logs under the local/docker profiles produce no email.
Red check: Putting the pre-fix com.sun.mail 2.0.2 jar back on the classpath made the smtp provider resolve to com.sun.mail.smtp.SMTPTransport instead of Angus; restoring the shipped classpath brought Angus back.

Automation: The shipped SmtpLogbackAppenderTest already covers the appender path; a GreenMail test for InternalNotificationService is proposed.
